# OPTIONAL_SITE_UI

OPTIONAL_SITE_UI: excluded from the Web denominator (R-AUD-003). The Web pack is the five PIPD_*.md documents.

These five files are a site UI pack: `index.html`, `app.js`, `styles.css`, `manifest.webmanifest`, `README.md`. They are NOT the PIPD Web documents and are never counted in the Web denominator.
